_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: SilverBullet
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A Markdown notes app in the browser, programmable with Lua and queries, that works offline. Sets up a first space and an admin account; more spaces and accounts are made in its dashboard.
startup: if [ ! -f data/server.json ]; then pw="{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}"; if [ -z "$pw" ]; then (umask 077; head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d "\n/+=" > admin-password.txt); pw=$(cat admin-password.txt); echo "Admin password is empty, so the admin account ({{ADMIN_USER}}) has the password in admin-password.txt."; fi; ./silverbullet setup --admin "{{ADMIN_USER}}:$pw" --space Notes data || exit 1; fi; exec ./silverbullet --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}} data

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SilverBullet: downloads the server release for the chosen version from
# GitHub (checked against GitHub's checksum). The data folder (your spaces,
# accounts and settings) is never touched; only the program is replaced,
# once the new one has arrived. The admin account is made at the first
# start.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=x86_64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=aarch64 ;;
    *) fail "SilverBullet has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=$(gh-release tag silverbulletmd/silverbullet "${want#v}") || fail "SilverBullet has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.12.1, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -x silverbullet ] && ./silverbullet version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^$version-"; then
    echo "SilverBullet $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading SilverBullet $version"
    gh-release download silverbulletmd/silverbullet "$tag" "silverbullet-server-linux-$arch.zip" "$work/sb.zip" ||
        fail "SilverBullet $version has no server download for this CPU (versions before 2.0 had none)."
    unzip -q -o "$work/sb.zip" -d "$work/x"
    [ -f "$work/x/silverbullet" ] || fail "The download isn't SilverBullet. Reinstall to try again."
    chmod +x "$work/x/silverbullet"
    mv -f "$work/x/silverbullet" silverbullet
fi
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed SilverBullet $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The SilverBullet version to install, such as 2.12.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The admin account's username, made at the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password, used only at the first start. Leave it empty to use a random one, saved in admin-password.txt.
